Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly asserted that “the city where the author died is Rome,” shifting focus to Rome’s governorship instead of Vatican City. Since Pope Pius XI (author of Quadragesimo Anno) died in Vatican City, the relevant office is Governor of Vatican City State (which ended in 1952). This misinterpretation would lead to pursuing the wrong office and an incorrect end year, causing the solution to go off track.
